numerator_definition: Routes whose synthetic route demand exceeds the vehicle payload capacity
denominator_definition: All route proxies with complete synthetic demand and vehicle payload data
what_high_value_means: Many route proxies exceed configured vehicle payload under synthetic demand.
what_low_value_means: Configured synthetic route demand usually remains within configured payload.
main_assumptions: Synthetic discrete-uniform customer demand and one manufacturer-specification vehicle
valid_interpretation: 現在の需要仮定では積載量制約がどの程度拘束的だったか。
invalid_interpretation: 東京都のEV配送では積載量制約が存在しない。
recommended_presentation_statement: 現在の需要仮定では積載量制約がどの程度拘束的だったか。

numerator_definition: Route proxies whose travel plus service duration exceeds the operating-time limit
denominator_definition: All route proxies with distance, speed, service time, and operating-limit values
what_high_value_means: Travel plus service duration often exceeds the configured operating limit.
what_low_value_means: Route proxies usually fit the configured limit under assumed speed/service time.
main_assumptions: Haversine distance with road multiplier, assumed speed, synthetic service time; no waiting/detour/charging event
evidence_status: Synthetic route proxy with assumed parameters
valid_interpretation: 現在の速度・時間上限・顧客数・route proxyの下で時間制約が拘束した。
invalid_interpretation: 東京都の実配送の同じ割合が時間内に終了しない。
recommended_presentation_statement: 現在の速度・時間上限・顧客数・route proxyの下で時間制約が拘束した。

numerator_definition: Route proxies whose estimated distance exceeds usable range
denominator_definition: All route proxies with route-proxy distance and usable-range values
what_high_value_means: Many route-proxy distances exceed configured usable range.
what_low_value_means: Most route-proxy distances fit configured usable range.
main_assumptions: Nominal range multiplied by initial-minus-reserve SOC ratio; no SOC trajectory
evidence_status: Manufacturer range with assumed usable ratio and route proxy
valid_interpretation: 現在のvehicle rangeとroute proxyでは途中補完なしで成立しない候補がある。
invalid_interpretation: 実車両が同じ割合で電欠する。
recommended_presentation_statement: 現在のvehicle rangeとroute proxyでは途中補完なしで成立しない候補がある。

main_assumptions: A sequential SOC trajectory and charger-arrival SOC are not modeled
invalid_interpretation: 単純な距離閾値によりSOC feasibleである。

display_name_ja: 充電器候補への地理アクセス
numerator_definition: Route proxies with no retained candidate within the condition-specific geographic threshold
denominator_definition: All route proxies under each charger condition
what_high_value_means: No screened candidate lies within the configured distance for many route proxies.
what_low_value_means: A screened geographic candidate is usually within the configured threshold.
main_assumptions: Distance from any route-proxy node to a screened OCM candidate; actual public availability is unknown
evidence_status: Public candidate geography with substantial attribute missingness
valid_interpretation: 設定した地理的・条件的閾値で候補が見つかるか。
invalid_interpretation: 実運用でも確実に充電器を利用できる。
recommended_presentation_statement: 設定した地理的・条件的閾値で候補が見つかるか。

display_name_ja: 単純化した充電補完可能性
metric_name: Unmet rate among range-infeasible route proxies
numerator_definition: Range-infeasible route proxies not supportable under the simplified two-usable-range and geographic-access rule
denominator_definition: Only route proxies that exceed usable range
what_high_value_means: Simplified geographic/two-range support still fails for many routes needing support.
what_low_value_means: The simplified support rule covers many routes that exceed direct range.
main_assumptions: Simplified geographic range-support proxy; charger-arrival SOC and actual stop choice are not evaluated
evidence_status: Simplified proxy with public candidate geography
valid_interpretation: 単純化した充電補完モデルでも解消できない航続距離条件が残る。
invalid_interpretation: 実車両が特定の充電器を特定時刻に利用する。
recommended_presentation_statement: 単純化した充電補完モデルでも解消できない航続距離条件が残る。

metric_name: Unmet rate among duration-evaluable range-infeasible route proxies
numerator_definition: Evaluable range-infeasible route proxies whose constant-power supplemental-duration proxy exceeds the threshold
denominator_definition: Only range-infeasible route proxies with an accessible compatible candidate and known positive power
what_high_value_means: Constant-power supplemental-duration proxy often exceeds the configured limit.
what_low_value_means: The simplified duration proxy often fits the configured limit.
main_assumptions: Constant reported power; no taper, efficiency loss, queue, operating hours, or event timing
evidence_status: Simplified duration proxy; actual charging behavior not evaluated
valid_interpretation: 一定出力の単純計算で補完時間が設定上限内か。
invalid_interpretation: 実際の充電時間・待ち時間・充電行動が予測できた。
recommended_presentation_statement: 一定出力の単純計算で補完時間が設定上限内か。
